intro: Trent Alexander-Arnold begins a pivotal second season at Real Madrid as he seeks to establish himself under manager José Mourinho, BBC Sport reports. The coming campaign is being framed as a defining period for the England international as he looks to demonstrate his value in one of the world's most demanding environments.

sections.heading: Why the second season often matters for high-profile transfers
sections.text:
A player's first year at a new club is frequently spent adapting to a different league, teammates and tactical demands. By the second season, expectations shift: coaches, supporters and the player themselves expect clearer evidence of integration and consistent contribution. That general pattern helps explain why Alexander-Arnold's upcoming campaign is being viewed as particularly significant.

Under a high-pressure manager like José Mourinho, who is known for setting exacting standards and pragmatic tactical frameworks, the margin for error can be small. Players who demonstrate clear tactical understanding and reliable performances are more likely to become regular starters. For Alexander-Arnold, the combination of adjusting to Real Madrid's squad dynamics and meeting a manager's demands creates a context in which this season will be closely scrutinized.

sections.heading: What Alexander-Arnold brings and the challenges he faces
sections.text:
Trent Alexander-Arnold is widely recognised for his creative passing, accurate crossing and set-piece delivery, attributes that have defined his reputation at club and international level. As an England international and a player who came to prominence in the Premier League, his technical strengths include range of passing and attacking instincts from the right flank — qualities any top club would value.

At the same time, adapting those strengths to the tactical blueprint preferred by Mourinho and the stylistic differences of Spanish football will be crucial. Real Madrid compete on multiple fronts — La Liga and European competitions among them — and the consistency required across a long season is demanding. Factors such as positional discipline, defensive responsibilities and the ability to link play with different team-mates will play into whether Alexander-Arnold can regularly influence games in the way performances at his previous club suggested.

analysis: This situation suggests a narrative common in elite football: a technically gifted player joins a major club and must translate individual flair into team-oriented, consistent performances. Under José Mourinho — a manager often associated with structure and results-first thinking — Alexander-Arnold's ability to combine creativity with defensive reliability will likely determine how central he becomes to Real Madrid's plans. Observers might see this season as a litmus test of both his adaptability and Mourinho's willingness to mould a naturally attack-minded full-back into his tactical setup.

faq.answer: Yes. According to BBC Sport, Trent Alexander-Arnold is entering a defining second season at Real Madrid as he looks to prove his worth under José Mourinho.

faq.answer: The report identifies José Mourinho as the manager under whom Alexander-Arnold will be attempting to establish himself.

faq.question: What will determine whether this season is a success for Alexander-Arnold?
faq.answer: Success will likely depend on how well he adapts to Real Madrid's tactical demands, maintains consistent performances across domestic and European competitions, and balances his attacking contributions with defensive responsibilities — general factors that influence any player's impact at a top club.

conclusion: BBC Sport frames this campaign as a crucial test for Trent Alexander-Arnold: his second season at Real Madrid under José Mourinho will offer a clearer picture of whether he can convert his well-known attacking qualities into the consistent, team-first performances required at the highest level.
